title: Polynomial Regression & Splines
interviewAnswer: Basis expansion lets linear models represent nonlinear relationships. High-degree global polynomials can behave badly at boundaries; splines build smoother local pieces joined at knots.
keyPoints: Model remains linear in coefficients despite nonlinear features.
why: Polynomial Regression & Splines appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
intuition: Model remains linear in coefficients despite nonlinear features.
deepDive: Basis expansion lets linear models represent nonlinear relationships. High-degree global polynomials can behave badly at boundaries; splines build smoother local pieces joined at knots. Splines give local flexibility. Regularization/knot choice controls complexity. workedExample: Model diminishing returns of ad spend using splines rather than a single straight line.
